description: This file defines MIDI-related constants and static utility methods for handling MIDI message bytes, including message length determination and Active Sensing checks.

classes.name: MidiConstants
classes.description: Contains MIDI message constants and static utility methods for MIDI message processing.

methods.name: getBytesPerMessage
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes in a MIDI message based on the status byte.

methods.name: isAllActiveSensing
methods.description: Checks if a byte array segment contains only Active Sensing messages.
